reason: I might take the free audit if I had a spare afternoon, but I do the billing myself every month and I know my clients. Even if it finds a few quid once, I fix it in the PSA and then I'm paying £240 a month for a check I already do.
objection: It finds the money once, then what am I paying for every month? After the first clean-up the monthly finds will be tiny, and I'm not handing my contracts and PSA data to a company I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit found well over £2,880 a year I genuinely accept, and a couple of MSP owners on r/msp I trust said it kept finding real money month after month, not just the first time.
